title: Unit 02 - Lesson 1 videos
body:
Here are some videos that may provide additional help if you missed these lessons in class or need to review them.

These videos have been updated to include the new AP vocabulary and AP form of the equations.  The older videos have been left below in case you just want to see and listen to your (possible) future Calculus teacher also teach this lesson, and those videos have other examples in them.

NOTE: the videos provided in Canvas are NEVER a replacement for being in class and taking part in class lessons and discussion.  The information provided in class ALWAYS supersedes anything you might see in one of the posted videos. Unit numbers and assignments maybe different, so always refer to Canvas or in-class instructions regarding assignments.
NOTE 2: there is a LOT of new vocabulary being introduced during this unit now that this is an AP Course. The warning above is even more relevant, since NONE of this new vocabulary will be in these videos. Also, in the videos, the standard form of trig functions will be given as
y = a sin (bx - c) + d  [ where sin could be replaced by any of the other 5 trig functions ]

whereas the AP Precalculus curriculum, as developed by College Board, presents the standard form as
y = a sin (b(x + c)) + d

In both cases, the period of the trig function is interpreted in the same way, but determining the phase shift, or Left Boundary, of the curve will be different. The differences will be covered in class.

This unit used to be Unit 5, so do not panic about the different unit number.
